defects.observed: Original P14 module name battle_core did not catch vendored CandidateRejected. An insufficient-energy request became INTERNAL_RESOLUTION_ERROR / COMMITTED / FAULTED. Energy stayed zero; authoritative state changed.
defects.root_cause: Identical Python source imported under two module names has distinct exception class identities. P15 hard-coded the vendored P14 class.
defects.change: P15 adapter requires caller-supplied rejection_type from the actual P14 owner module; P14 source unchanged.
defects.fixed_observation: REJECTED / ENERGY_INSUFFICIENT; all authoritative state bytes unchanged; energy zero.

evidence_corrections.detail: The first double-click test checked cache size, which did not prove the provider was never called. It was changed to count actual propose invocations. Historical passing logs remain unmodified.
